pattern.crimePattern: a remand prisoner's sister books a poisoned food parcel in for the man her brother fears, under the man's wife's name; the cell's food captain eats it instead
pattern.notes: Fictional prisoners, officers and families; the remand prison is a setting only and its officers are shown as overworked and mostly honest. Fundi names the man in the government car as Raphael Oduya (the 4th-floor photo, case 86). His full confession comes after the verdict and closes t_fundi.

ob.text: A remand prisoner, Douglas Njuguna (29), died at 17:40 after eating from a food parcel; two cellmates are in hospital. The parcel was booked in for Benedict Mbuvi, "Fundi" (case 50).

facts.text: Douglas Njuguna died in Block C at 17:40 on Tuesday after eating from a food parcel booked in for Benedict Mbuvi; two cellmates are in hospital.
Douglas collapsed after vomiting; two cellmates have the same symptoms.
The parcel tag: "For: B. Mbuvi, Block C — From: Mrs. Mbuvi — 12:15". Chicken stew and rice.
Victor: when a man is out, the food captain shares his parcel. Douglas ate the most, at about 13:00. "Nobody outside knows that. It's just how a cell is."
Duty book: Musa was in the punishment block from Monday 18:00 to Wednesday 08:00.
Visitor register, Tuesday 12:10: "Mutheu Mbuvi", an ID number, a signature, "food parcel for B. Mbuvi".
Past registers: Rhobi Chacha visits Daniel Mwita in Block A every Tuesday at 11:30, today included.
Escort log: Benedict Mbuvi was out at Milimani from 07:00 and back in Block C at 16:50.
Lucy: "Fundi came back and saw Douglas carried out. He sat on the floor. He asked me for paper, a pen and a lawyer, in that order."
Lucy was in the welfare office with a family all afternoon.
ID database: the number written at 12:10 belongs to Rhobi Chacha, not Mutheu Mbuvi.
Mutheu's employer: she was at work in Machakos all Tuesday. Mutheu: "Benedict hates chicken stew."
Under Fundi's mattress, logged by the censor three weeks ago: "You know what happens to men who talk. — D.M."
Records: Monday 20:00 Rhobi's phone at a Kitengela agrovet; PesaPap KSh 1,450, "pesticide, 250 ml".
Behind Rhobi's kitchen door: the pesticide bottle, a third used.
Rhobi's set of plastic tubs, the same make as the parcel, is one short.
Signature specimens from Rhobi Chacha.
Post-mortem: organophosphate pesticide poisoning; no injuries.
Post-mortem: eaten at about 13:00; death at 17:40, witnessed.
Toxicology: the same organophosphate in the stew and in Rhobi's bottle; no other drug.
Handwriting: the "Mutheu Mbuvi" signature at 12:10 is in the same hand as Rhobi's Block A entries.
Rhobi: "I visit only my brother, at half past eleven. I've never brought food for anyone else."
Rhobi: "My brother said that man would hang him with his mouth. I cooked it that morning. I didn't know about the cell sharing. I'm sorry for the boy."
Rhobi: "The bottle is for my kitchen garden. It never went near any food."
Fundi: "I don't know any Mwita."
Fundi: "The man who paid me for the Bahati road came in a government car, a Lands House pass on his lanyard." Shown the 4th-floor photo, he points to Raphael Oduya.
Sgt. Mumo: "I checked every visitor's ID against their face."
Sgt. Mumo: "Forty in the queue, one officer. I looked at a card, not a face. Another officer carried it to Block C." She accepts the discipline.
Mutheu: "I wasn't there."
Musa: "I steal food. I was in the punishment block."

interrogations.intro: Rhobi sits with her handbag on her knees. "I visit only my brother, at half past eleven. I've never brought food for anyone else."
Fundi sits on the floor of the interview room and won't take the chair. "I don't know any Mwita."
Sgt. Mumo stands. "I checked every visitor's ID against their face."
Mutheu, on the phone from Machakos, is crying. "I wasn't there."
Musa grins. "I steal food. I was in the punishment block."
Lucy has already pulled the register. "Run the ID number. I'll wait."

contradictions.reaction: "Forty people in the queue and one officer. I looked at a card, not a face. I'll accept the discipline."
"My brother said that man would hang him with his mouth. I'm his sister. I did what my brother asked. I didn't know about the cell sharing. I'm sorry for the boy."
Fundi looks at the note for a long time. "He came in a government car," he says. "A Lands House pass." Shown the photograph from the fourth floor, he points without hesitating.
Rhobi closes her handbag and folds her hands on it.

timeOfDeath.reason: A poisoning prepared in advance: the act is putting pesticide in the stew that morning, and alibis for 13:00 don't clear anyone.
timeOfDeath.note: The act window is when the stew was poisoned; Douglas ate at 13:00 and died at 17:40.

proof.concludes: The poisoned parcel was for Fundi, who was in court; Douglas ate it as the cell's food captain.
"Mrs. Mbuvi" wrote Rhobi Chacha's ID number.
Rhobi is Mwita's sister; Mwita had threatened Fundi; Fundi names the man in the car from the 4th-floor photo.
She bought the pesticide on Monday and cooked the stew on Tuesday morning.
The bottle, the tub set one short, and her hand on the register.
Rhobi Chacha poisoned the stew meant for Fundi, to silence him for her brother.

reconstruction.text: Since case 90 Major Mwita has been on remand in Block A. He knows Fundi is the one man in the prison who could tie Mvua's money to a killing twelve years old. Three weeks ago he sends Fundi a note through an inmate.
On Monday evening his sister Rhobi buys a bottle of pesticide in Kitengela. On Tuesday morning she cooks chicken stew and rice and stirs it in.

At 11:30 she signs in to see her brother. At 12:10 she signs again as "Mutheu Mbuvi", writing her own ID number, and books the parcel in for Benedict Mbuvi. Sgt. Mumo, with forty in the queue, glances at a card.
Fundi is at Milimani for a mention. At one o'clock Douglas, the cell's food captain, shares out the stew, as a cell always does when a man is out. He dies at 17:40.

afterVerdict.beat: Fundi asks for Amani, Halima and a new lawyer: his old one was Sharon Kiprop. He has written six pages in pencil.

"Twelve years ago a man came in a government Land Cruiser. Grey suit, a Lands House pass. Two hundred thousand and a name: Joseph Mwenda, surveyor, Bahati. He said, 'The desk wants him to stop.' I did it, on the Bahati road, with a tyre lever. He told me to take the notebook too. The limp was my idea."

files.text: Closed with a statement: Fundi confesses to killing Joseph Mwenda for KSh 200,000 from a man in a government car, whom he names as Raphael Oduya: "He said 'the desk' the way you say 'the weather'."
The killer named: Benedict Mbuvi, "Fundi". The man in the car: Raphael Oduya.

afterVerdict.beat: Amani's notebook: "Fundi killed Dad. Oduya was in the car. 'The desk wants him to stop.'" The desk is quiet for a long moment. Then a text from Mwalimu: "I heard. Eat something. I'm coming to Nairobi on Friday."

clockPlan.note: Two stamps: records on Rhobi's line and a warrant on her kitchen. Detain Rhobi after the search; handwriting (10 h) and toxicology (18 h) inside 24 h.
